composition_subtypes.role: Binary lifting to compute jump pointers for cyclic shifts
Range minimum query over precomputed endpoints

payload.core_composition_summary: DP (binary lifting) precomputes jump pointers; segment tree answers range minimum queries on those endpoints to check cyclic shift existence.
payload.rationale: Solution uses binary lifting (DP) to compute, for each index, the end position after n-1 steps following the cyclic order, then builds a segment tree to answer range minimum queries. This is a true composition of DP and data structure.
